bead.title: Expose hybrid async runtime profile
bead.description: Wire runtime configuration for objectlog/hybrid-async while preserving existing strict behavior. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-server/src/env_config.rs, crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs, crates/pqueue-server/src/bin/pqueue-service.rs, charts/pqueue/*, docs/deployment/*. Reject unsupported backend pairings fail-closed. Add Helm values/schema/static validation for hybrid-async settings and document env vars. Out of scope: load evidence.
bead.acceptance:
1. cargo test -p pqueue-server env_config hybrid_async -- --nocapture passes.
2. cargo test -p pqueue-server --test server objectlog_hybrid_async -- --nocapture passes.
3. bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh passes.
4. cargo fmt --check passes.
